arguments.subject: Romania distribution opportunity | iFLYTEK AI devices | 1,000+ employee group
arguments.body:
Dear iFLYTEK Sales Team,

We would like to explore becoming an authorized distributor of iFLYTEK products in Romania, starting with AI Glasses, AINOTE 2 and AINOTE Air 2.

We are a Romanian software development company that builds business applications and programs robots and robotic arms. We are part of a group with more than 1,000 employees and annual turnover exceeding EUR 40 million, with commercial relationships spanning over 40 countries.

We have already purchased one pair of iFLYTEK AI Glasses, one AINOTE 2 and one AINOTE Air 2 for evaluation. Our aim is to introduce a reliable AI productivity and communication solution offering exceptional value for money, first to colleagues within our group and subsequently to customers in Romania.

For iFLYTEK, this offers a practical route into the Romanian market: an internal evaluation environment, software integration expertise and an established international business network. We would like to build demand through demonstrations, relevant business use cases and local customer support.

Could you please share:
- Your distributor or reseller requirements and the current availability of representation in Romania.
- Export pricing, recommended retail prices, minimum order quantities, volume discounts and demo-unit terms.
- Lead times, delivery and payment terms, warranty arrangements and after-sales support for Romania.
- Which versions of these products are supported for use in Romania, including official mobile apps, account activation and available languages.
- The appropriate contact for a discussion about an initial pilot and a potential distribution agreement.

We also intend to integrate the devices with our own software and explore Romanian-language adaptations through your authorized SDKs or APIs. Please connect us with the relevant product teams if hardware distribution is managed separately from the Open Platform.

Would your team be available for a short introductory video call to discuss the commercial opportunity and next steps?

Best regards,

arguments.subject: Technology partnership proposal | Romanian localization and robotics integration
arguments.body:
Dear iFLYTEK Partnerships Team,

We would like to explore a technology partnership to integrate iFLYTEK products with our software and develop Romanian-language adaptations for business users.

We are a Romanian software development company building business applications and programming robots and robotic arms. Our company is part of a group with more than 1,000 employees and annual turnover exceeding EUR 40 million. The group maintains commercial relationships in over 40 countries.

We have purchased one pair of iFLYTEK AI Glasses, one AINOTE 2 and one AINOTE Air 2 as a starting point for evaluation. We see an opportunity to combine your devices and AI capabilities with our applications for multilingual communication, meeting documentation and, where supported, voice interaction with robotics workflows.

Our proposed starting point is a focused pilot with colleagues in Romania. We would validate the user experience, assess Romanian speech recognition, transcription and translation options, and identify integrations that deliver measurable practical value. A successful pilot could support wider adoption within our group and a distribution initiative in Romania.

Could you help us establish:
- Access to the relevant device SDKs, APIs, documentation, sample applications and developer program.
- Supported integration methods for each device, including companion-app integration and access to audio, transcripts or notes where available.
- Current Romanian-language capabilities and the permitted options for localization, custom vocabulary and integration with our own language services.
- Licensing terms for internal development, commercial integration and distribution of adapted solutions.
- Availability of a sandbox, evaluation credentials and a technical contact for the pilot.

Our contribution would be software engineering, robotics expertise, Romanian-language testing and access to real business workflows. We are looking to build a dependable solution with outstanding value for money and a clear path from technical validation to commercial adoption.

If these devices are handled by separate business units, please introduce us to the appropriate teams. We would welcome an initial technical and partnership call to define a realistic pilot scope.

Best regards,

These setup details are internal. User-facing progress updates should be less technical in nature.
